core_memory.michael_final_purchase_summary: Michael is ready to finalize purchase. He wants current items(grinder, canister, cleaning kit), upcoming(steam wand, subscription), and a clear order guide. Has provided all needed details.
core_memory.michael_billing_security_check: Michael is using the same address and card as before. He’s concerned about security holds, recalling a past Apple Pay issue. He wants to be proactively informed of any red flags to avoid reliving that experience.

core_memory.michael_positive_feedback_customer_servi: Michael praises the timely and thorough responses to his customer service inquiries, whether about billing or return policy. He appreciates the personal touch and suggests streamlining support channels so agents can instantly access his full purchase history when switching between chat or email.
core_memory.michael_final_feedback_gratitude_and_rec: Michael thanks the brand for high-quality, stylish products that boost his productivity and client confidence. He shares coffee creations on Instagram(@coffee_creations_1237) and is happy to recommend the brand.

He’d like membership to reduce this friction—ideally with free shipping on all orders and bonus perks like sample-size coffee flavors or occasional discount codes on future machines. He’s open to any enhancements that support his ongoing pursuit of the perfect coffee experience.
